message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on 18 June 1815, resulted in roughly **23,000–25,000 total casualties** (killed, wounded, missing).  

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French & allies (Napoleon’s forces) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch‑Prussian coalition (Wellington’s forces) | ~22,000 |

These figures are rounded estimates from contemporary reports and modern scholarship; exact numbers vary slightly among sources.
